test_title: PYST 29: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people F, H, K, G, J, D, and L are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only two people sit to the right of G. Only two people sit to the left of J. H sits between G and J. K sits between J and L. F sits between G and D. Who sits at the extreme right of the row?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Only two people sit to the right of G. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7767580ee11eee01771ad9e04d9b072cbad625afd23db5b5b457d40300bcdde7.png] 

2) Only two people sit to the left of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a63b73b3cfc349b0dcb5935540cc943365a7cd5ce5cdab97d02cbf7ac094628.png] 

3) H sits between G and J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3e0525249d025025603ea68c6548a6238ae11abf8f87de22d1dc5191d0dd5a2.png] 

4) K sits between J and L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6611933c346dd5f03dd3c3750dfa57cc24bab2a403e9de0ff7e456f48b3089c7.png] 

5) F sits between G and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1838b698e3484d4c731f89968edbc9f679eefcfa185f0a0d211aa15bf866b878.png] 

Here, we can see that D sits at the extreme right of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"D"**.
